title: Todo Management - Create, Complete, Filter and Delete
description: As a user, I want to manage my tasks so I can track what remains to be done.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A new task with valid text appears in the list.
A user can mark a created task complete and see its completed state.
The Active filter hides completed tasks and shows active tasks.
A user can remove a task and it no longer appears in the list.
